preconditions.description: The number of castles n must be between 1 and 40.
The amount of liquid k must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= a[i][j] <= 1 for j in range(n)) for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The adjacency matrix must contain only 0s and 1s.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i][j] == a[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: The adjacency matrix must be symmetric.
The diagonal of the adjacency matrix must be all zeros.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible sum of stabilities of the walls.
